hints.title: Independent Character Contributions
hints.text: Instead of tallying vowels per substring, calculate each vowel character contribution independently.

hints.title: Combinatorial Substring Count
hints.text: A character at index i is included in (i + 1) * (n - i) distinct contiguous substrings.

hints.title: Accumulation Formula
hints.text: Sum the product across all vowel positions.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: A character at index i appears in (i + 1) * (N - i) distinct substrings.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating substrings takes O(N^2) time and causes time limit exceeded.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Contribution counting achieves optimal linear time without storing substrings.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should derive the combinatorial contribution formula for each index.
